title: Deep learning predicts and in vitro experiments validates the synergistic anti-liver cancer effect of vincristine and lenvatinib: Mechanism involving apoptosis induction via the TNF-α/Caspase-8 pathwa
summary: Cell assays and ZIP analysis support the predicted drug combination; perturbation experiments support the proposed apoptosis pathway. No patient efficacy is established.
organization: Guangxi University; Guangxi University of Chinese Medicine
